Title: Requires the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a statewide critical infrastructure security, condition and resilience assessment program
Summary: Requires the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a statewide critical infrastructure security, condition and resilience assessment program for the purpose of identifying vulnerabilities, evaluating infrastructure reliability and preparedness, and developing recommendations to reduce risks to public health, safety, security and economic stability; provides that such assessments shall be conducted at least once every three years.
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the executive law, in relation to establishing a statewide critical infrastructure security, condition and resilience assessment program
